newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves hit new high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves hit new high.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves hit a new all-time high of $10.272 billion as of June 27, the latest date for which official figures are available, the central bank said Tuesday.

It said net reserves had increased by $4.6 million between June 20 and 27, down from a weekly average of about $10 million throughout most of the year to date. The latest increase stemmed from a $33 million rise in the country's gross international reserves, according to the Banco de la Republica.
Net foreign reserves rose $375.5 million between Jan. 1 and the June 27 cutoff date against the central bank's $750 million target for the entire year.
